entry.title: New: Bill 219 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS SECTION 25-8-22 (PUNA DISTRICT ZONE MAP), ARTICLE 8, CHAPTER 25 (ZONING CODE) OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM AGRICULTURAL – 20 ACRES (A-20a) TO FAMILY-AGRICULTURAL – 1 ACRE (FA-1a), KEA‘AU, PUNA, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 1-6-003:081 AND 129 (Applicant

Graphic Images Hawaiʻi, Inc.) (Area: 26.762 acres) The Windward Planning Commission forwards its favorable recommendation for this change of zone request, which would allow the applicant to subdivide the property into 23 lots. The property is located at 16-790 Keaʻau-Pāhoa Road.

Latest action: Council: Bill 219, Draft 2, passes second and & final reading - 12/18/24
